description: Get the Swiss Residential Property Price Index (SWRPI) — official BFS data. Baseline Q4 2019 = 100. Returns quarterly index values tracking Swiss property prices since 2009. Covers all properties, single-family houses, and apartments separately.

from.description: Start period (inclusive). Format: "2020Q1", "2020-Q1", or just "2020". Defaults to earliest available (2009-Q4).

to.description: End period (inclusive). Format: "2024Q4", "2024-Q4", or just "2024". Defaults to latest available.

type.description: Property type to filter by: "all" (combined index), "houses" (single-family), "apartments" (condominiums/flats). Defaults to "all".

name: get_property_price_index
